name: kidneys
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One SQUARE anatomy picture card for Body School ages 11–13. White background, centered subject with generous margins, softly shaded clean textbook illustration, natural reddish-brown kidneys and pink bladder. No gore, words, labels, arrows, letters, border, watermark, genitals or reproductive organs. Show a matching pair of complete external human kidneys, reddish-brown bean-shaped organs with concave hilums facing inward toward each other. No cutaways and no extra organs. Only short natural hilum stubs if necessary, no long ureters. Both kidneys entirely within frame.

name: ureters
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One SQUARE anatomy picture card for Body School ages 11–13.
